jobs.title: Director of Economics & Pricing
jobs.description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omni-channel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis—our operating platform unifying a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services—to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins.

With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and more—premier home and outdoor banners that double as real-world innovation hubs. CSC Generation continues to grow through M&A, revitalizing companies with strong brand recognition and loyal customers.

CSC Generation is building an internal economics and pricing decision system
to improve cash recovery, margin, and capital efficiency across closed-out, at-risk, and healthy inventory.

This role is the single-threaded owner
of that system.

You’ll operate at the intersection of pricing, inventory, finance, data science, and engineering — turning high uncertainty into structured decisions that run daily and move real dollars.

This is not
a pure analytics or engineering role. It’s a product-ownership and economics leadership role.

What You Get To Do

Own the economic framework behind pricing and inventory disposition (contribution margin, holding cost, option value).
Define and evolve the Bleeder / At-Risk / Healthy inventory classification and policies.
Lead structured research and experimentation in ambiguous, low-signal environments.
Partner with data science on time-to-sell, demand, and elasticity models — pushing for interpretability and actionability.
Use LLMs pragmatically to accelerate hypothesis generation, feature ideation, matching, and model evaluation (with guardrails).
Partner with engineering to productionize daily decisioning, guardrails, monitoring, and overrides.
Establish trust through explainable recommendations, governance, and post-mortems.
Apply formal reasoning where useful (constraints, invariants, checkable rationales) to ensure decisions are valid and auditable.

What You Bring

8+ years in pricing, inventory, revenue management, marketplace economics, or applied data science in retail/e-commerce.
Proven ability to create clarity and momentum in high-uncertainty problem spaces.
Strong command of unit economics and expected-value thinking.
Experience influencing or owning systems that drive daily financial decisions.
Comfort working across data science, engineering, merchandising, and finance.

Nice to Have

Experience with clearance / markdown optimization or liquidation.
Familiarity with hazard models, demand modeling, or experimentation.
Hands-on experience using LLMs in analytics or decision systems.
Background in formal logic, constraint systems, or verification-style thinking.

What’s in it for you? Joining CSC Generation isn’t just about having a seat at the table—it’s about helping redesign the table entirely. You’ll be challenged, stretched, and supported as you grow faster than you thought possible. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer

Executive Access: Work directly with brand CEOs and senior leadership, solving real business problems and earning mentorship from top operators.
AI-First Skill Building: Get hands-on with the most advanced AI tools in the market. From automation to prompt engineering, you’ll build a modern tech stack that sets you apart in any industry.
Accelerated Career Path: High performers are quickly entrusted with greater responsibility, new challenges, and leadership opportunities across our portfolio of brands.
Competitive benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k)/RRSP match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts at our portfolio companies.

Our Interview Process

📞 Step 1: If you align with our vision and meet the qualifications, we’ll reach out to schedule a conversation and introduce CSC.
🧠 Step 2: You’ll complete a short AI or product-building challenge so we can understand how you approach problems and execution.
💬 Step 3: Participate in deep-dive interviews with CSC leadership focused on your experience, product mindset, and operational thinking.
📩 Step 4: Offer. We’ll move fast for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Vice President, Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
Indero has retained Pender & Howe to lead the recruitment initiative for their Vice President, Medical Affairs position.

For consideration, please email a copy of your CV in confidence to: Céline Chabée, Partner, celine.chabee@penderhowe.com or Oliver Kuehm, Associate Director, Executive Search, oliver.kuehm@penderhowe.com

The Vice President, Medical Affairs
is a newly defined executive mandate created to bring Indero's Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance (PV) functions under unified, senior physician leadership as the organization scales across a growing therapeutic and geographic footprint. This is a broader mandate than a Medical Monitoring leadership role: it carries P&L accountability for both functions, a direct hand in business development and client-facing bid defense, and a seat at the Operational Leadership Team table advising the Chief Medical & Scientific Officer (CMSO) on medical, scientific, and safety risk across the trial portfolio.

As Indero's study footprint extends from North America and Europe into Asia Pacific, this role will be central to ensuring medical and safety standards scale consistently with the organization's growth. Reporting to the Executive and leading the Global, Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance function, the VP will set strategic direction for both functions - from physician resourcing and medical monitoring SOPs to PV case processing, signal detection,aggregate reporting, and regulatory inspection readiness, while safeguarding the safety of trial participants, the integrity of clinical data, and the quality of every deliverable the organization produces. Because the two functions sit at different points in a trial's lifecycle but share a single safety and quality lens, the role calls for a leader equally comfortable adjudicating a complex protocol-level medical decision and defending a PV inspection finding to a health authority.

This is a global team of roughly 20 across Medical Monitoring, Pharmacovigilance, and medical project operations, with three functional leaders reporting directly to the VP. The role also carries meaningful external accountability.

The VP will partner with Business Development and Proposals on RFP responses and full-service Medical Affairs engagements, participate directly in client presentations and bid defenses, and serve as the senior medical point of contact for key sponsor accounts -- work that puts the VP's scientific credibility and executive presence in front of the clients Indero is working to win and retain.

This opportunity will appeal to a physician executive who has already led and scaled a Medical Monitoring or Pharmacovigilance function inside a CRO or pharmaceutical organization, who is comfortable owning a budget and revenue targets alongside patient safety and quality outcomes, and who wants a genuine seat at the table shaping Indero's next chapter of growth.

Responsibilities

﻿Strategic Leadership & Division Management

Partner with the CMSO to develop and execute the long-term strategic vision for the Medical
Affairs division, aligned with Indero's overall growth strategy and competitive positioning in
the CRO marketplace.
Own the operating budget and P&L for the Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance
functions, ensuring financial discipline, resource optimization, and delivery against revenue
and margin targets.
Build short- and long-term capability roadmaps for Medical Monitoring and
Pharmacovigilance that keep pace with evolving regulatory requirements, sponsor needs,
and industry best practice.
Champion a culture of scientific excellence, patient safety, operational rigor, and continuous
quality improvement across Medical Affairs.
Represent Medical Affairs at the Operational Leadership Team level, serving as a key advisor
to the CMSO on medical, scientific, and safety risk matters.
Drive cross-divisional collaboration with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics,
Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Scientific Affairs and Business Development to ensure
integrated program delivery.

Medical Monitoring Oversight

Provide executive oversight of all medical monitoring activity across Indero's clinical trial portfolio, spanning multiple therapeutic areas.
Ensure medical monitoring teams deliver high-quality, protocol-compliant medical oversight.
Maintain and evolve Indero's medical monitoring model to meet diverse client needs and therapeutic complexity.
Lead physician resourcing strategy, including hiring, training, deployment, and performance management.
Ensure Medical Monitoring SOPs, work instructions, and quality standards are maintained, reviewed, and compliant with applicable regulatory guidelines.
Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-risk medical monitoring issues, including protocol-related medical decisions, safety signal identification, and sponsor-facing medical disputes.

Pharmacovigilance Oversight

Provide strategic and operational oversight of the PV function, ensuring robust, audit-ready systems for case processing, signal detection, aggregate reporting, and regulatory submissions.
Ensure the organization meets its pharmacovigilance obligations across global jurisdictions and country-specific PV legislation.
Oversee preparation and quality review of aggregate safety reports to meet sponsor and regulatory deadlines with accuracy and scientific integrity.
Champion the evolution of PV technology platforms and evaluate AI- and automation-driven efficiencies in signal detection, case processing, and literature monitoring.
Lead the organization's readiness for PV regulatory inspections and internal audits, serving as a key spokesperson during health authority interactions related to pharmacovigilance.
Partner with sponsor Medical Safety Officers and PV teams to establish and maintain transparent pharmacovigilance agreements (PVAs) and safety data exchange agreements (SDEAs).
Ensure ongoing training and competency assessment of PV staff in case processing, medical coding (MedDRA), safety signal evaluation, and regulatory reporting.

Business Development & Client Engagement

Partner with Business Development to win new business, with particular focus on full-service
Medical Affairs engagements.
Participate in client presentations, bid defense meetings, and RFP responses, articulating
Indero's Medical Affairs value proposition.
Develop and nurture strategic client relationships, acting as the senior medical point of
contact for key accounts to drive satisfaction and long-term retention.
Lead development of competitive pricing models for Medical Affairs services in collaboration
with Finance and Business Development, ensuring quotes reflect realistic resourcing and
margin targets.
Represent Indero in scientific and industry forums to build the organization's thought leadership and brand in Medical Affairs.

﻿Quality, Compliance & Regulatory

Ensure all Medical Affairs activities comply with applicable regulations, Indero's Quality
Management System (QMS), and sponsor requirements.
Serve as executive-level signatory and accountability owner for Medical Affairs SOPs, quality plans, CAPA plans, and audit/inspection responses.
Partner with Quality Assurance to define audit schedules for Medical Monitoring and PV, and to review and close audit findings in a timely, thorough manner.
Monitor evolving global regulatory requirements relevant to Medical Affairs and proactively prepare the division for them.
Build a quality-first culture and hold the Medical Affairs team accountable for regulatory compliance and data integrity at every level.

﻿People Leadership, Talent & Organizational Development

Lead, mentor, and inspire a multidisciplinary Medical Affairs team.
Design and implement a workforce planning strategy that anticipates staffing needs based on pipeline growth, therapeutic area expansion, and geographic diversification.
Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive, high-performance culture where talent is developed, recognized, and retained.
Develop and execute career pathing, succession planning, and leadership development programs to build a robust internal talent pipeline.
Establish performance management frameworks and KPIs for all Medical Affairs functions, and deliver regular coaching and developmental feedback.
Partner with HR on compensation benchmarking, onboarding, and retention strategy for medical and scientific talent in a competitive market.

Requirements:

IDEAL PROFILE

﻿Education

Medical doctor (MD, DO, or equivalent international medical degree) required.
Board certification in dermatology or rheumatology is an asset but not required; a strong generalist physician background is acceptable.
Advanced business training (e.g., MBA) is an asset but not required.

Professional Experience

12-15 years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or clinical research industry, including 5-7 years in a leadership role within a CRO, pharmaceutical company, or hybrid organization.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance functions.
Proven track record of client engagement in a commercial, revenue-generating environment.
Deep expertise in global clinical trial regulatory frameworks.
Meaningful exposure to multiple therapeutic areas.
Experience with health authority interactions, regulatory inspections, and audit defense.
Experience managing P&L or budget responsibility.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or scaling an established Medical Affairs function.
Working knowledge of PV safety databases and safety reporting automation tools.
Exposure to AI-assisted technologies in medical monitoring, PV, or medical writing workflows.
Published authorship of peer-reviewed scientific manuscripts or presentations at major clinical/scientific conferences.
Multilingual capability or international regulatory experience.

Our company:

Indero has retained Pender & Howe
to lead the recruitment initiative for their Vice President, Medical Affairs position. Pender & Howe is a North American talent advisory firm specializing in leadership recruitment and consulting. We partner with organizations to build high-performing leadership teams, optimize board effectiveness, and support executive career transitions.

Our team of accomplished consultants brings deep industry expertise and a global perspective, delivering tailored, retained search and advisory services that help organizations attract, assess, and retain top-tier talent. We work closely with human capital leaders, governing boards, and executives, offering a consultative approach that aligns leadership with strategic business goals.

With a presence in key North American cities—including Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, Edmonton, Boston, and New York—we offer both local expertise and global reach. As a proud member of Kestria, the world’s largest executive search alliance, we extend our impact across 40+ countries and 90+ cities, enabling seamless talent solutions for international organizations.

Pender & Howe is driven by the belief that diversity fuels innovation. We champion inclusive leadership and strategic growth, helping organizations navigate the evolving landscape of executive talent. Whether partnering with venture-backed innovators, private equity firms, or multinational enterprises, we are committed to shaping the future of leadership.

For more information, visit penderhowe.com

For consideration, please email a copy of your CV
in confidence to:

Céline Chabée, Partner, celine.chabee@penderhowe.com

Oliver Kuehm, Associate Director, Executive Search, oliver.kuehm@penderhowe.com

﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

Working conditions

Fast-pace

jobs.description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

Bounteous is seeking a Director of Marketing Technology to serve as a senior, consultative Multi-Solution Architect within our Digital Experience Platforms practice. This role is designed for a seasoned marketing technology leader who combines deep platform expertise with strong client advisory skills, and who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, architecting solutions, and contributing directly in a billable capacity across client engagements.

While Adobe Experience Cloud represents a dominant ecosystem within the Bounteous practice, this role is intentionally multi-platform. The Director is expected to bring strong Adobe expertise alongside working knowledge of complementary marketing technology platforms and patterns, including CRM, CDP, marketing automation, analytics, and personalization technologies. The role spans both B2B and B2C use cases, with an emphasis on data-driven orchestration, lifecycle marketing, and measurable business outcomes rather than CMS- or DAM-centric implementations.

This position serves as a bridge between sales and delivery, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and platform partners while also setting delivery teams up for success. The Director balances strategic leadership with hands-on, billable client work, helping clients modernize their marketing technology ecosystems and extract long-term value from their platform investments.

Information Security Responsibilities

Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Role And Responsibilities

Multi-Solution Architecture and Strategy

Serve as a senior, consultative marketing technology architect across multiple platforms and solutions
Lead the design of scalable, data-driven marketing technology architectures that support both B2B and B2C customer journeys.
Architect solutions spanning CDP, marketing automation, journey orchestration, analytics, personalization, and CRM integrations.
Provide architectural guidance across dominant Adobe platforms as well as complementary technologies where appropriate.
Translate business objectives into platform architectures, data models, integration patterns, and activation strategies.
Maintain awareness of evolving MarTech capabilities, ecosystem trends, and emerging technologies.

Client Advisory and Billable Delivery

Act as a trusted, consultative advisor to client stakeholders, guiding platform selection, roadmap planning, and architectural tradeoffs.
Maintain an active billable role across client engagements, contributing directly to discovery, solutioning, and delivery oversight.
Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, demos, and executive presentations.
Partner with delivery teams to ensure solutions are implemented in alignment with architectural intent and best practices.
Support escalation, troubleshooting, and course correction on complex marketing technology programs.

Pre-Sales, Growth, and Partnerships

Partner with client service and business development teams to support pursuits, pitches, and account expansion.
Support pre-sales solutioning through consultative discovery, estimates, and solution narratives.
Identify opportunities to create packaged offerings, accelerators, and repeatable solution patterns
Collaborate with platform partners, including Adobe and other MarTech vendors, on roadmap awareness, co-innovation, and solution alignment.

Governance, Enablement, and Thought Leadership

Guide clients in establishing marketing technology governance models, operating models, and Centers of Excellence.
Define best practices for data stewardship, consent management, orchestration, and measurement.
Provide thought leadership in the marketing technology space, helping position Bounteous as a trusted partner for enterprise MarTech transformation.
Mentor architects and senior practitioners, contributing to internal enablement, frameworks, and best-practice playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

10 or more years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering marketing technology solutions.
3 or more years of experience in a digital-first, global delivery agency or consultancy.
Deep experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, including platforms such as Adobe Experience Platform, Journey Optimizer, Marketo Engage, Customer Journey Analytics, and related tools.
Working knowledge of non-Adobe MarTech platforms such as Salesforce, Braze, Iterable, or similar, with the ability to architect across ecosystems.
Strong understanding of CRM, CDP, analytics, identity, and data integration patterns.
Proven ability to operate in a consultative, client-facing role while maintaining billable delivery responsibilities.
Demonstrated success translating complex technical ecosystems into measurable business outcomes.
Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

jobs.title: Dedicated Support Engineer - Toronto
jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About The Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.

In This Role, You Will

Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.
Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.
Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers.
Own the customer-specific response to high-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post-incident follow-through.
Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.
Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.
Partner with Go-to-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes.
Represent Support Engineering in relevant customer meetings, including QBRs, and partner closely with account teams to communicate technical health, surface risks and blockers early, coordinate follow-up, and provide customers and internal stakeholders with clear, proactive updates.
Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations.
Prepare for important launches, migrations, traffic increases, and business events by developing account-specific runbooks, validating escalation paths, coordinating support readiness, and providing heightened monitoring where needed.
Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.
Translate recurring customer pain into clear, evidence-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, with a particular focus on improving the reliability and performance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.
Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI-powered automation.
Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally.

Have significant experience in Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or another role involving hands-on diagnosis of complex production issues.
Have expert-level troubleshooting skills and a strong track record of resolving ambiguous technical problems across APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations.
Are comfortable working with logs, metrics, traces, API requests, authentication flows, and customer-provided code or configurations to understand system behavior and test hypotheses.
Have experience leading or playing a central role in customer-impacting incidents, including severity assessment, technical coordination, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, and post-incident follow-through.
Can write code or scripts to reproduce issues, interrogate systems, automate repetitive work, and improve internal tools. Experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar languages is valuable.
Can communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders—especially when information is incomplete or evolving.
Build strong, high-trust relationships with customers and cross-functional partners while maintaining clear and scalable ownership boundaries.
Look beyond the immediate issue to identify patterns, improve the system, and prevent the same problem from recurring.
Thrive in ambiguity, update quickly as new information emerges, and are willing to learn whatever is needed to get the job done.
Bring a humble, team-first mindset, strong judgment, and a genuine eagerness to help both customers and colleagues succeed.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Medical Affairs
new_jobs.description:
Indero has retained Pender & Howe to lead the recruitment initiative for their Vice President, Medical Affairs position.

For consideration, please email a copy of your CV in confidence to: Céline Chabée, Partner, celine.chabee@penderhowe.com or Oliver Kuehm, Associate Director, Executive Search, oliver.kuehm@penderhowe.com

The Vice President, Medical Affairs
is a newly defined executive mandate created to bring Indero's Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance (PV) functions under unified, senior physician leadership as the organization scales across a growing therapeutic and geographic footprint. This is a broader mandate than a Medical Monitoring leadership role: it carries P&L accountability for both functions, a direct hand in business development and client-facing bid defense, and a seat at the Operational Leadership Team table advising the Chief Medical & Scientific Officer (CMSO) on medical, scientific, and safety risk across the trial portfolio.

As Indero's study footprint extends from North America and Europe into Asia Pacific, this role will be central to ensuring medical and safety standards scale consistently with the organization's growth. Reporting to the Executive and leading the Global, Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance function, the VP will set strategic direction for both functions - from physician resourcing and medical monitoring SOPs to PV case processing, signal detection,aggregate reporting, and regulatory inspection readiness, while safeguarding the safety of trial participants, the integrity of clinical data, and the quality of every deliverable the organization produces. Because the two functions sit at different points in a trial's lifecycle but share a single safety and quality lens, the role calls for a leader equally comfortable adjudicating a complex protocol-level medical decision and defending a PV inspection finding to a health authority.

This is a global team of roughly 20 across Medical Monitoring, Pharmacovigilance, and medical project operations, with three functional leaders reporting directly to the VP. The role also carries meaningful external accountability.

The VP will partner with Business Development and Proposals on RFP responses and full-service Medical Affairs engagements, participate directly in client presentations and bid defenses, and serve as the senior medical point of contact for key sponsor accounts -- work that puts the VP's scientific credibility and executive presence in front of the clients Indero is working to win and retain.

This opportunity will appeal to a physician executive who has already led and scaled a Medical Monitoring or Pharmacovigilance function inside a CRO or pharmaceutical organization, who is comfortable owning a budget and revenue targets alongside patient safety and quality outcomes, and who wants a genuine seat at the table shaping Indero's next chapter of growth.

Responsibilities

﻿Strategic Leadership & Division Management

Partner with the CMSO to develop and execute the long-term strategic vision for the Medical
Affairs division, aligned with Indero's overall growth strategy and competitive positioning in
the CRO marketplace.
Own the operating budget and P&L for the Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance
functions, ensuring financial discipline, resource optimization, and delivery against revenue
and margin targets.
Build short- and long-term capability roadmaps for Medical Monitoring and
Pharmacovigilance that keep pace with evolving regulatory requirements, sponsor needs,
and industry best practice.
Champion a culture of scientific excellence, patient safety, operational rigor, and continuous
quality improvement across Medical Affairs.
Represent Medical Affairs at the Operational Leadership Team level, serving as a key advisor
to the CMSO on medical, scientific, and safety risk matters.
Drive cross-divisional collaboration with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics,
Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Scientific Affairs and Business Development to ensure
integrated program delivery.

Medical Monitoring Oversight

Provide executive oversight of all medical monitoring activity across Indero's clinical trial portfolio, spanning multiple therapeutic areas.
Ensure medical monitoring teams deliver high-quality, protocol-compliant medical oversight.
Maintain and evolve Indero's medical monitoring model to meet diverse client needs and therapeutic complexity.
Lead physician resourcing strategy, including hiring, training, deployment, and performance management.
Ensure Medical Monitoring SOPs, work instructions, and quality standards are maintained, reviewed, and compliant with applicable regulatory guidelines.
Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-risk medical monitoring issues, including protocol-related medical decisions, safety signal identification, and sponsor-facing medical disputes.

Pharmacovigilance Oversight

Provide strategic and operational oversight of the PV function, ensuring robust, audit-ready systems for case processing, signal detection, aggregate reporting, and regulatory submissions.
Ensure the organization meets its pharmacovigilance obligations across global jurisdictions and country-specific PV legislation.
Oversee preparation and quality review of aggregate safety reports to meet sponsor and regulatory deadlines with accuracy and scientific integrity.
Champion the evolution of PV technology platforms and evaluate AI- and automation-driven efficiencies in signal detection, case processing, and literature monitoring.
Lead the organization's readiness for PV regulatory inspections and internal audits, serving as a key spokesperson during health authority interactions related to pharmacovigilance.
Partner with sponsor Medical Safety Officers and PV teams to establish and maintain transparent pharmacovigilance agreements (PVAs) and safety data exchange agreements (SDEAs).
Ensure ongoing training and competency assessment of PV staff in case processing, medical coding (MedDRA), safety signal evaluation, and regulatory reporting.

Business Development & Client Engagement

Partner with Business Development to win new business, with particular focus on full-service
Medical Affairs engagements.
Participate in client presentations, bid defense meetings, and RFP responses, articulating
Indero's Medical Affairs value proposition.
Develop and nurture strategic client relationships, acting as the senior medical point of
contact for key accounts to drive satisfaction and long-term retention.
Lead development of competitive pricing models for Medical Affairs services in collaboration
with Finance and Business Development, ensuring quotes reflect realistic resourcing and
margin targets.
Represent Indero in scientific and industry forums to build the organization's thought leadership and brand in Medical Affairs.

﻿Quality, Compliance & Regulatory

Ensure all Medical Affairs activities comply with applicable regulations, Indero's Quality
Management System (QMS), and sponsor requirements.
Serve as executive-level signatory and accountability owner for Medical Affairs SOPs, quality plans, CAPA plans, and audit/inspection responses.
Partner with Quality Assurance to define audit schedules for Medical Monitoring and PV, and to review and close audit findings in a timely, thorough manner.
Monitor evolving global regulatory requirements relevant to Medical Affairs and proactively prepare the division for them.
Build a quality-first culture and hold the Medical Affairs team accountable for regulatory compliance and data integrity at every level.

﻿People Leadership, Talent & Organizational Development

Lead, mentor, and inspire a multidisciplinary Medical Affairs team.
Design and implement a workforce planning strategy that anticipates staffing needs based on pipeline growth, therapeutic area expansion, and geographic diversification.
Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive, high-performance culture where talent is developed, recognized, and retained.
Develop and execute career pathing, succession planning, and leadership development programs to build a robust internal talent pipeline.
Establish performance management frameworks and KPIs for all Medical Affairs functions, and deliver regular coaching and developmental feedback.
Partner with HR on compensation benchmarking, onboarding, and retention strategy for medical and scientific talent in a competitive market.

Requirements:

IDEAL PROFILE

﻿Education

Medical doctor (MD, DO, or equivalent international medical degree) required.
Board certification in dermatology or rheumatology is an asset but not required; a strong generalist physician background is acceptable.
Advanced business training (e.g., MBA) is an asset but not required.

Professional Experience

12-15 years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or clinical research industry, including 5-7 years in a leadership role within a CRO, pharmaceutical company, or hybrid organization.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance functions.
Proven track record of client engagement in a commercial, revenue-generating environment.
Deep expertise in global clinical trial regulatory frameworks.
Meaningful exposure to multiple therapeutic areas.
Experience with health authority interactions, regulatory inspections, and audit defense.
Experience managing P&L or budget responsibility.

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of PV safety databases and safety reporting automation tools.

Published authorship of peer-reviewed scientific manuscripts or presentations at major clinical/scientific conferences.
Multilingual capability or international regulatory experience.

Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.
Partner with Go-to-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes.
Represent Support Engineering in relevant customer meetings, including QBRs, and partner closely with account teams to communicate technical health, surface risks and blockers early, coordinate follow-up, and provide customers and internal stakeholders with clear, proactive updates.
Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations.

Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.
Translate recurring customer pain into clear, evidence-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, with a particular focus on improving the reliability and performance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.
Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI-powered automation.
Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally.
